# Mastering Observability: Slide Design System v2.0

**Updated:** 2026-06-15. The brand's slide language for decks, talks and lead-magnet visuals. v2.0 supersedes the v1.0 system below. The reference implementation is the Vendor Engagement Deck, generated by `build_deck.js` in `08_Revenue/Vendor_Engagement_Toolkit/_deck_source/`. Allan approved this look on 2026-06-15 and asked that all presentations carry it.

> **Migration note.** v1.0 (dark master, Archivo Black, `mo_slide_template.js`) is retained only for the existing FAB teaser deck. New decks use v2.0. Older v1.0 assets get restyled to v2.0 over time, not all at once.

## Principles

One body of thinking, many outputs. Slides carry the same voice as the writing: calm authority, evidence over slogans, no AI tells, no em dashes, UK English, GBP. Every slide earns a visual element; no plain title-and-bullets pages. Confirmed figures only. Pricing never appears on outward-facing vendor or sales decks; it is quoted after the conversation.

## Canvas and layout

- **Widescreen canvas: 13.3 x 7.5in (PowerPoint `LAYOUT_WIDE`, 16:9).** This is the v2.0 change from v1.0's 10in canvas.
- Margins ~0.6in. Content sits inside a generous, uncrowded grid; leave breathing room.
- **Light and dark slides alternate** ("sandwich"): dark title and section slides, light content slides. Title, divider and closing slides are dark; most content slides are light (cream).
- Three-card rows are the workhorse layout: card width ~3.85in, gutter ~0.25in.

## Themes and palette

Pulled from masteringobservability.com so the deck, site and OG cards match.

**Dark slides (title, section, closing).**

| Token | Hex | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Navy (bg) | `0D2127` | Slide background |
| Navy 2 | `13313A` | Faint decorative circles / corner motif |
| Card dark | `1C3C45` | Panels and cards on dark slides (lighter than bg for separation) |
| Teal | `2F9E8D` | Left accent bar, accent fills |
| Bright teal | `74DDCD` | Headings, stat numbers, kickers on dark |
| Body on dark | `C9D6D8` / `D5E0E1` | Body and card text on dark |

**Light slides (content).**

| Token | Hex | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Cream (bg) | `F5F3EC` | Slide background |
| White | `FFFFFF` | Cards |
| Tint | `EAF6F3` | Icon circles, soft header bands |
| Ink | `16282D` | Titles and primary text |
| Teal | `2F9E8D` | Kickers, stat numbers, accent bars, tags |
| Muted | `5D6F73` | Captions, descriptions, footer |

One colour dominates each slide (navy on dark, cream on light); teal is the single sharp accent. Amber is not used in v2.0.

## Typography

Brand-installed fonts (in `06_Brand_Assets/fonts/`). PowerPoint cannot embed via the generator, so install these on any machine presenting the deck.

| Role | Font | Sizes (on the 13.3in canvas) |
|---|---|---|
| Display / titles | **Montserrat** (Bold) | Hero title 46pt, section titles 32-34pt, card numbers 22-26pt |
| Body / cards | **DM Sans** | Body 15-16pt, card headers 14-19pt bold, captions 10.5-12pt |
| Kickers / labels | **DM Sans** bold caps with light letterspacing (`charSpacing 3-4`) | Eyebrow kickers 12-14pt, footer 9pt. (Space Mono is available for code/mono contexts but the standard kicker is letterspaced DM Sans caps.) |

Titles are kept to **one line** wherever possible; long titles are shortened, not wrapped, to avoid colliding with the kicker above or the body below.

## Components and motif

- **Kicker + title block** at top left of every content slide: teal mono-style caps kicker, then the title in Montserrat. Leave a clear gap; never let a wrapped title run into the kicker or the body.
- **Cards:** sharp-cornered rectangles with a soft outer shadow (`blur 8, offset 3, opacity ~0.16`). A thin teal accent bar tops or sides feature cards. Icons sit in tint (light) or tint-on-dark circles.
- **Left accent bar:** a 0.28in teal vertical bar down the left edge of dark slides.
- **Corner motif:** faint navy/teal circles bleeding off a corner on dark slides, kept clear of all text.
- **Icons:** single-colour line icons (teal on light, bright teal on dark), generated by `genicons.js` (minimal SVGs rasterised with ImageMagick). 24x24 viewBox, ~256px PNG.
- **Footer** on light slides: "Mastering Observability  ·  masteringobservability.com" left, slide number right, in muted DM Sans.

## Slide archetypes (in the reference deck)

1. **Hero title (dark):** kicker, two-line Montserrat title, thesis line, name + role, URL, corner motif.
2. **Profile / who-I-am (light):** title + body paragraph left, stacked stat cards right.
3. **Big-idea (dark):** kicker, title, lead paragraph, three supporting cards.
4. **Stats (light):** row of big-number stat cards over a dark summary band.
5. **Three-lane table (light):** three comparison cards, one emphasised (dark fill) as the "hot" option.
6. **Icon grid (light):** 2x3 cards, each an icon circle + title + tag + description.
7. **Offer / process flow (dark):** numbered 3-step flow with connecting arrows over an accent summary bar.
8. **Principles (light):** three icon cards over a quote band.
9. **Next steps / contact (dark):** numbered steps + contact band with icons.

## Regenerating or extending

`build_deck.js` (in the toolkit `_deck_source/`) is the reference generator: brand tokens at the top, then slide builders. Run with Node + `pptxgenjs`; icons via `genicons.js` + ImageMagick (`convert`). To make a new deck, copy the source, swap the slide content, keep the tokens and component patterns. `sharp` and `react-icons` are NOT used (they were unreliable in the build sandbox); icons are pre-rendered PNGs.

Retained for the FAB teaser deck only. Dark master theme, background navy `#0A0E17`, panels `#0F2B2D`; Archivo Black / DM Sans / Space Mono; 10in 16:9 canvas; sharp panels with thin borders and no shadows; crosshair/lens motif; built by `mo_slide_template.js`.
